name: Deploy Ponder Indexer to VPS

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "raffled-indexer/**"
      - ".github/workflows/deploy-indexer.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Deploy on VPS
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.VPS_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.VPS_USER }}
          password: ${{ secrets.VPS_PASSWORD }}
          port: ${{ secrets.VPS_PORT }}
          command_timeout: "20m"
          script: |
            set -e
            export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
            [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
            cd /home/admin/repos/RAFFLED-CONTRACTS/raffled-indexer
            git fetch origin main
            git reset --hard origin/main
            npm ci
            npm run codegen
            pm2 delete raffled-indexer || true
            pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs
            pm2 save
            echo "pm2 saved"
            echo "Waiting for /health..."
            for i in $(seq 1 60); do
              if curl -fsS http://localhost:42069/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo "Ponder is up."
                break
              fi
              if [ "$i" -eq 60 ]; then
                LATEST_LOG=$(ls -t ~/.pm2/logs/raffled-indexer-out*.log 2>/dev/null | head -1)
                if [ -n "$LATEST_LOG" ] && grep -q "previously used by a different Ponder app" "$LATEST_LOG" 2>/dev/null; then
                  echo "Schema app-id mismatch (config identity changed). Dropping stale schema and retrying..."
                  node -e "
                    const fs = require('fs');
                    const env = fs.readFileSync('.env.local', 'utf8');
                    let url = env.match(/DATABASE_URL=(.+)/)[1].trim();
                    if (/[?&]sslmode=(require|prefer|verify-ca)(&|\$)/.test(url) && !/[?&]uselibpqcompat/.test(url)) url += (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'uselibpqcompat=true';
                    const { Client } = require('pg');
                    (async () => {
                      const c = new Client({ connectionString: url });
                      await c.connect();
                      await c.query('DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS \"main\" CASCADE');
                      await c.end();
                      console.log('dropped schema main');
                    })().catch((e) => { console.error('schema drop failed:', e.message); process.exit(1); });
                  "
                  pm2 restart raffled-indexer
                  sleep 10
                  if curl -fsS http://localhost:42069/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                    echo "Ponder is up after schema reset."
                    break
                  fi
                  echo "Still unhealthy after schema reset. Recent logs:"
                  pm2 logs raffled-indexer --lines 50 --nostream
                  exit 1
                fi
                echo "Ponder did not become healthy after 60s. Recent logs:"
                pm2 logs raffled-indexer --lines 50 --nostream
                exit 1
              fi
              sleep 2
            done
            echo "Ready status (200 = backfill complete, 503 = still syncing):"
            curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /ready -> %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:42069/ready || true
            echo "GraphQL endpoint: http://$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}'):42069/graphql"
